title: Build a balanced home compost pile
subcategory: Build a balanced home compost pile
summary: Turn suitable kitchen and garden material into a stable soil amendment.
steps: Choose a drained location away from direct contact with food preparation areas.
Alternate moist nitrogen-rich material with dry carbon-rich material; cut bulky pieces smaller.
Keep the pile damp like a wrung sponge, not waterlogged.
Mix or turn when it compacts, smells strongly or stops breaking down.
Use only when material is dark, crumbly, earthy-smelling and no longer recognisably fresh.
